answer: An agent marketplace for tide forecasts, glacier surveys, and karst maps requires a separate 100-token bond for each active bidder, locked for 30 days, and allows one bid per bond per round. Creating new identities therefore creates no free bidding capacity: an attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous bids must immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, bearing financing costs and price risk even if every bond is eventually returned.
